mapper.select: SELECT COUNT( a.`id` ) `num`, b.`type_name` `typeName` FROM `announcement` a LEFT JOIN `model_type` b on a.`type`=b.`id` GROUP BY a.`type` ORDER BY `num`

SELECT a.`id` `id`, a.`title` `title`, a.`notice_time` `noticeTime`, a.`content` `content`, a.`create_by` `createBy`, a.`creator_id` `creatorId`, a.`creator_type` `creatorType`, a.`level` `level`, a.`type` `type`, b.`type_name` `typeName`, p.`type_name` `publish_agency`, t.`type_name` `tag_name` FROM `announcement` a LEFT JOIN `model_type` b ON a.`type` = b.`id` LEFT JOIN `model_type` p on p.`id` = a.`publish_agency` LEFT JOIN `model_type` t on t.`id` = a.`tag_id` where a.`id` = #{id}
